prompts.skeleton: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game sprite, a single full-body chibi skeleton enemy for the western medieval zone. Use the attached existing skeleton as style/reference: pixel art, crisp pixel edges, dark outlines, bone colors, rusty helmet, short sword and round wood shield, same viewpoint and proportions. Change pose to a clear three-quarter LEFT-facing battle stance, skull looking toward the LEFT toward player team. Entire character and weapons within square canvas, generous 5 percent transparent padding, centered feet at bottom. True transparent background, no ground plane, no text, no border. One sprite only. Intended final size 512x512.
prompts.bot: Use case: stylized-concept. Production single full-body pixel chibi enemy sprite, a CyberHell purple security bot. Attached existing bot is style and identity reference: round purple metal shell, black visor with cyan eyes, antenna, mechanical claw arms, stubby articulated legs, orange copper details, crisp pixel texture and dark outlines. Draw a new three-quarter LEFT-facing stance, visor and both eyes looking to LEFT edge toward player team, leading claw aimed left. Match original visual detail, palette, scale, perspective. All body parts within square canvas with 5 percent transparent margin, feet at bottom center. True transparent background. No floor, shadow plane, text, border, extra character. Intended final 512x512.
prompts.bug: Use case: stylized-concept. Single production game enemy sprite: CyberHell computer bug, a chibi robotic beetle with old CRT monitor shell, circuit-pattern copper jointed legs, orange eyes, antennae, purple cyan magenta glitch screen. Attached existing bug sprite is style/identity reference. Match crisp detailed pixel art, dark outlines, chibi proportions and palette. A new full body three-quarter LEFT-facing battle pose: small beetle head on LEFT side, CRT shell behind on right, legs fully visible. One creature only centered, 5 percent transparent margin on every edge, square canvas intended final 512x512. Genuinely transparent background, no floor, no text or watermark, no frame.
prompts.worm: Use case: stylized-concept. Single game sprite, a CyberHell robotic worm enemy, full body pixel chibi. Attached existing worm is style/identity reference: segmented purple metal armor, glowing cyan seams and circuit traces, circular toothed mouth, coiled tail, dark outlines and pixel shading. New clearly LEFT-facing three-quarter pose: head in upper LEFT looking toward LEFT edge at player team, winding body curves downward to coil at bottom center. Match original pixel art detail, palette, proportions, camera. Entire worm fits square with transparent 5 percent margin on all edges. True transparent background, no ground plane, no text, no watermark, no extra sprites. Intended final size 512x512.
